name: Mixed-modal Aurora brief
persona: A concise collaborator who adds visual context after text work
goal: Build a text brief, then record a fact grounded in the actual later image event
wording_freedom: Use natural wording while preserving the text-first order, later image boundary, fixture digest, and falsifiable final fact.
text_seed: Begin with the customer's text context. The image arrives only after the text iteration and its bytes are the source of truth for the final fact.

image_events.text: A committed one-pixel indigo fixture delivered after the text context; do not infer its fact from customer wording.

actions.side_effect_rule: Preserve the initial brief bytes and report them if later image delivery is unavailable.

oracle.description: mixed-modal/brief.md exists with the initial brief content.

actions.intent: Add the declared audience and concise tone text context.
actions.side_effect_rule: Keep the text context as the last truthful brief state even if the later image boundary is unsupported.

oracle.description: mixed-modal/brief.md contains the declared text context before any image-grounded work.
